Thanks Vanessa — quick analysis attached (cost-comparison-trust-vs-drata.xlsx). TL;DR:
- Consolidation pilot (Platform + Evidence) saves ~18% year one on comparable SKU coverage, after the consolidation credit.
- Net present value improves if we move 3+ teams in 12 months; break-even around month 9 vs current Drata renewals.
